purpose: One episode-specific creative strategy per episode, produced by creative_director as a RECOMMENDATION for human review. The direction says WHY / WHAT EXPERIENCE at section/movement altitude; specialists decide HOW inside their domains; QC independently tests whether the draft satisfies the declared intent.

authority.agent_module: scripts/creative-director.js (AGENT_ID creative_director; dispatch remains fail-closed until Mikko's enablement decision)

script_identity_kinds: CANDIDATE_SCRIPT (DISCOVERY_PACKAGE: canonical_idea_id + source_fingerprint + datasheet_fingerprint + script_variant + script_sha256)

consistency_rules: script identity is bound exactly; any drift voids the direction (SCRIPT_IDENTITY_DRIFT)
style reference binding is sha-pinned via the style-reference adapter; ACTIVE_ADVISORY requires human-approval evidence; absence is declared, never fabricated (STYLE_AUTHORITY_FABRICATED)

every human constraint in the task is echoed verbatim with a compliance statement; typed constraints are deterministically checked; contradiction is CONSTRAINT_CONTRADICTION — validation failure, never a warning
conflicting human constraints (e.g. TONE_SERIOUS vs TONE_MORE_HUMOR) ESCALATE with both positions preserved; the director never resolves them by synthetic consensus
PRESENTER_FREE draft policy requires a concrete compensation_directive (P-02 continuous-visual-life equivalence)
visual_mode_mix weighs all six visual functions exactly once
intentional deviations always cite a pattern/principle id, carry a creative reason, and require human approval — the director never self-approves a deviation
human_decisions_required is capped at 4 consequential typed escalations — over-escalation is as invalid as over-deciding
forbidden vocabulary (shot geometry, asset selection, script text, timing values, infrastructure, approvals) is rejected recursively
stored direction digest matches canonical serialization; direction revisions are immutable and strictly monotonic

downstream_consumers.visual_planning_director: specialistProjection: full strategy fields — decides beats/shots/cards/treatments itself
downstream_consumers.editor: pace character, density arc, emphasis moments, relief, ending energy — decides cuts/holds/transitions itself
downstream_consumers.sound_music_director: sound_music_intent + music lock — decides cues/mix itself
downstream_consumers.qc_director: the approved direction as sha-bound intent evidence; QC verdicts never route through the director

lifecycle_note: Module existence is not an authority claim. creative_director stays DEFINED / NOT_PROVEN / DISABLED until the registry enablement prerequisites are met and Mikko records an enablement decision (governance/creative-director-enablement.json, imitating the presenter_director record).
